reviews.t: I dig it - still like it months later
reviews.x: So I decided to grow my hair out and I'm at that lovely not-quite-long-enough for a ponytail but too long for letting it hang down in my face stage. I picked up this headband in the hopes that it would be more secure as I played sports, was active in the yard etc. It does hold my hair back and looks pretty good while it does so. I have moderately curly hair (big loose curls) and this pulls the front back securely enough that it goes straight without being so tight that it rips hairs out of my sc

I would say my head is average size and my hair is rather thick. Yet this headband still pinched ever so slightly on my head. BUT that isn't even the biggest problem... the biggest problem is the black coating. The coating wears away very very easily, only to reveal the silver metal underneath.  You get what you pay for I guess.

I've had this headband for almost a year and have pretty much abandoned (haha, see what I did there) all my others. I have a very full head of hair and this band holds up very well.  It is very comfortable and doesn't get caught or pull my hair.  Even though it holds firm to my head, it usually doesn't pinch or feel too tight.  I'm tempted to order a couple more in case I lose this one because I don't want to be without it.
Pros: Nice metal construction and lightweight. Holds hair in place firmly. Cheap price.  Cons: Paint is all gone within the first month.

reviews.t: and I couldn't get it to be a perfect "U" again
reviews.x: This isn't even worth $1. It came in the shape of a "P" instead of a "U", and I couldn't get it to be a perfect "U" again. The ends hurt your head, and it doesn't conform to your head correctly.

reviews.t: ive worn this every day for over a year
reviews.x: i like it a lot, i even got a 2nd one for times i couldnt find the first, however the coating does wear off rather quick and you cant wear this with wet hair otherwise it will get rusty.
Great for guys with longer hair without being to feminine. If you have a bigger head you may need to stretch the ends a little bit apart so it doesn't start to irritate after a while.

I want to save my hair for longer. I don't want my hair to block my eyes when I'm using the computer at home. A headband is a good aid for that purpose. This does the job but is a bit too tight. It hurts after wearing it for a few hours.
Perfect for anyone with long hair.  Not easy to find something like this in stores.  I recommend this product.  Go for it!!!
it is good as i expected, perfectly fit my head and hair. and the price is also very cheap. Strongly recommend

These are nice because they can be bent and shaped to fit any size head. I bought them for my son to keep his hair out of his eyes when playing soccer and they worked, but he decided to go with elastic bands because he didn't want to have the metal out on the field while he was playing. He gave them to his little sister and she loves them. They are easy to adjust to a little smaller size to fit her, and she likes the pattern they make in her hair and that they stay put. They are well constructed and comfortable.  I really wasn't expecting much for what I paid, but it was definitely worth the buy if you want it.  It did take more than two weeks for delivery though, so just keep that in mind.
i have a larger-size head (i can only wear sunglasses that are 6" wide, for example) and this did not work for me. It didn't reach down quite far enough. gonna give it to my daughter i guess.

Very useful thank you. Although its a little bit tight and press your head, it fix the front hair well

reviews.t: it is comfortable and keeps the hair in place well
reviews.x: While this headband is not necessarily attractive, it is comfortable and keeps the hair in place well.  I have always liked the headband hairstyle, but most headbands (if plastic or metal) put too much pressure behind my ears and eventually cause headaches, or (if fabric) don't stay in place very well.  This headband does not have either of those problems, even though my hair is much thinner than it used to be.

I wanted this kind of hair band to give that wavy look i like the most.  It worked in that perspective, however it gives me headache if i wear it for more than 4 hours, so after 1 hour rest period, i wear it again.  So far, i'm happy with this purchase, its sturdy, gives the desired look , only glitch is little too tight on head, else i would recommend it to my friends.

I really love this headband. I bought it quite a long time ago, and I still have it (: Personally I like wearing this when my hair is curly. It is metal, so it did put a little too much pressure on my head, but I could actually open it and force it to give a little.

reviews.t: Good headband for guys, but paint will chip
reviews.x: It is a good metal headband. Bend it how you like to fit comfortably, I am a guy and it fits great after adjusting a bit. Paint looked good quality at first, but it started chipping after only a few wears. Got a big issue for me, but it will happen

reviews.t: It's also easy to adjust if it's pressing too tightly on your ...
reviews.x: It ships amazingly fast and holds hair in place well without snagging it.  It's also easy to adjust if it's pressing too tightly on your head (or too loosely) -- nothing a light bend won't fix.
This headband fits well and is cute. It is not too small and I have a large head compared to most people (I am 5'9"). I love the design and is great to wear casually or more dressy.

reviews.t: Does exactly what I want it too
reviews.x: I got this as my hair was getting in my way a lot of the time and this pins it back without any frizz. I like to wear this when my hair is straight as it leaves nice lines in my hair.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the headband comfortable and effective at holding hair back, with several noting it stays in place well.
A common complaint is that the black coating or paint wears off quickly, revealing the metal underneath.
Some reviewers report the headband is too tight or pinches, causing discomfort, especially for those with larger heads.
Several reviewers appreciate that the metal band can be bent and adjusted to fit different head sizes.
A few reviewers mention slow delivery times.
